summary: Re-test of 'Modificar (Nueva Versión)' feature after bug fixes. ALL TESTS PASSED. The two critical bugs from iteration_19 have been fixed: 1) mapService now correctly maps item_name→medio_pago_name and unit_price_usd→tarifa, 2) canShowItems condition allows displaying items in edit mode even when integrator/pinpad/sponsor are null.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - minor accessibility issue
Console warnings about hydration error: <tr> cannot be child of <span>, <span> cannot be child of <tbody> - React rendering structure issue but doesn't affect functionality
